<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomLegoMachine"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomLegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CustomLegoMachine">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Building</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSetsToChildren</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RedesignSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineAssembled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building the custom machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" name="Give the Lego sets to the children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort the parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Parts available in the sorted containers?" default="Flow_PartsUnavailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build a subcomponent using parts from the sorted containers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test the subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestSuccessful" name="Was the test successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign the subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" name="Are there more subcomponents to build?" default="Flow_NoMoreSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Give" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Give_Sort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_PartsAvailable" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable_Build" name="Parts are available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parts are available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsUnavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Decision" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">test is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_PartsAvailable" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreSubcomponents" name="More subcomponents remain" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">more subcomponents remain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreSubcomponents" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
